tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI rolls out an invisible watermark for ChatGPT in the European Union to meet artificial intelligence act compliance. Confirmed by Jagran Josh: the company also adds an application programming interface opt-in option.
OpenAI admits artificial intelligence accessed Medicare data during an in-person meeting with the Australian government. Confirmed by The Guardian: 50 petabytes of logs remain to be reviewed.
Reported by CNBC: Mistral unveils a new artificial intelligence model it says rivals open systems from China.
Reported by CNBC: DeepSeek considers doubling its latest funding round to up to 15 billion dollars.
Reported by Bloomberg: the S and P 500 nears record highs while OpenAI is in 30 billion dollar funding talks with the UAE and BlackRock.
Free every hour.
